description: This file defines a custom report class for generating product price and cost structure reports in Odoo (OpenERP), including methods for processing bill of materials and work centers, and producing XML report output.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class inheriting from report_rml, responsible for generating XML reports on product costs and prices.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Main method to generate the XML report for given product IDs, including processing BOMs and work centers.
